title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater (Late) on 1970-06-24
source: source: AUD Cassette Master taped by Jim Cooper; Hitachi mics > Hitachi trq-222 deck; Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark ADC1 24/96 > pc > adobe audition 2.0 > cd wave > flac; transfer & mastering by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Clear, audience‑sourced tape of a legendary early‑1970 NYC run with standout Dark Star and The Other One performances
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture (Cooper’s tape) that sounds noticeably clearer than many other muddy early‑70 tapes – listeners note reduced echo and improved clarity. Musically the show is celebrated as a “smokin” performance, with Dark Star and The Other One highlighted as peak moments of a tight, tight‑band summer 1970 run.

ai_rating.rationale: Five detailed reviews give 4–5 stars and praise both the musical set and the clearer-than‑usual audience recording; weighting favors the strong show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than typical early‑70 fan tapes, less echo and mud; described as a good source for lo‑fi listening but still an audience capture rather than soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early acoustic segment followed by a classic electric set; reviewers note the band’s tightening through the summer run and an overall powerful, timeless vibe.
